caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object that appears to be a decorative glass vase or pedestal dish, centrally positioned on a plain beige background. The object is rendered in a reddish-brown or maroon tone. The top of the object features a wide, shallow bowl with a ruffled, wavy edge. Below the bowl, the neck of the object tapers inward and then expands into a series of three bulbous, spherical sections stacked vertically, each decorated with diagonal, hatched shading to indicate texture or transparency. The base is a small, flat circular platform supporting the entire structure. There are minor imperfections and spots visible on the background, and a small printed signature or label is visible near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Stiegel Vase
